title: Camps — Add camp: Early drop-off and Late pick-up already there
subtitle: Add camp → Start from Blank camp → 4. Extras, PC 1280. Today a blank camp starts with no extras. After, it starts with the two lines filled in: Per day, still removable with ✕ for a camp that doesn't offer them. Edit camp and existing camps don't change. A camp started from a template keeps the template's own extras. Amber = what changes.

items.caption: Blank camp: “No extras”. You press + Add extra twice and type both lines every time.

A. Both lines start with the name and Per day. You type the price for each camp; until you do, the section says “2 extras have no price” and Save is blocked, so a camp can't go out with a wrong or missing price.

B. Both lines start fully filled in, prices too ($15 and $8 here are only the preview's examples — you'd give me the real ones). Nothing to type, but if a price changes later it's in the code, so changing it needs a small update from me.

footer:
Recommendation: B if the two prices are the same for every camp; A if they change from camp to camp. Either way it's an app-only change (no database change), and the fake preview's camps don't change.

Your choice: A or B? For B, tell me each one's price per day (and, if you want them in the name, the times, e.g. “Early drop-off, 7:30–9:00 AM”).
